/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
p = 'src/data/lyrics/husaina-husaina.md'
def parts(s):
    _, yaml, body = s.split('---\\n', 2)
    return yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1], body
roman, body = parts(Path(p).read_text())
assert body == parts(check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p], text=True))[1]
def blocks(s):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert len(r) == len(u) == 8
for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(r[1:], u[1:]), 1):
    assert a[0].strip() == str(i) and b[0] == chr(0x6f0+i)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in u]
print([len(b) - (i > 0) for i,b in enumerate(r)], sum(map(len,r))-7)
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/husaina-husaina.md"

item.text: Audited [husaina-husaina.md](src/data/lyrics/husaina-husaina.md) verse by verse. Both versions already contain 64 verses, aligned across the preamble and seven stanzas. Corrected four Roman lines for spelling and word spacing. The Urdu body and metadata were preserved. The pronunciation of `waae` was retained for human editorial review.
